summary: Unit tests give fast feedback: rds_instance's 16 unit tests run in under 2 seconds versus over an hour for integration tests. Every module should have at least one unit test, and adding one when bug fixing is worthwhile.
questions: Should every Ansible module have a unit test?
Is it worth adding a unit test when I fix a module bug?
How much faster are unit tests than integration tests?

answer_card.title: Unit tests for quick feedback
answer_card.answer_md: Yes. As a baseline every module should have at least one unit test, and it's worth adding one when fixing a bug. Example: rds_instance integration runs take over an hour (one step can take 20 minutes), while its 16 unit tests finish in under 2 seconds.
